description: This Java source file defines the final class AliasesAppender, which implements a UnaryOperator<Config>. It extends a given Config object by adding alias keys for existing configuration entries, where the aliases are derived from a JSON object string specified in an environment variable. The class provides methods for instantiating itself, parsing system environment variables, and applying alias mappings to the Config.

classes.name: AliasesAppender
classes.description: A final class implementing UnaryOperator<Config>. It adds alias configurations to an existing Config object based on a JSON string of aliases provided via environment variable.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate AliasesAppender relying on environment variable CONFIG_ALIASES for alias definitions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies alias mappings to the provided Config object, returning an extended Config with aliases included.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a JSON object string into a Map of alias to original key, logging the process.

methods.name: tryToGetOriginalValueOrNull
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the value for an original key from Config, returning null and logging a warning if unsuccessful.

methods.name: getOriginalValueOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key from Config; throws if key does not exist.
